summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its addition to the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX), effective June 19, 2026, following GDX's quarterly rebalance. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine index inclusion, not a special situation transaction. The filing is an informational update; there are no structural changes, shareholder vote, risk-arb angle, or regulatory clock to monitor.
